<?php
namespace Review147Vendor {
    interface First147 {}
    interface Second147 {}
    class Base147 {}
}
namespace Review147Use {
    use Review147Vendor\First147 as Contract147;
    class Deferred147 implements Contract147 {}
    function make147() {
        $o = new class implements cONtract147 { public int $number = 4; };
        return $o;
    }
    $a = make147();
    echo $a::class, "|", $a->number, "|";
}
namespace Review147Use {
    use Review147Vendor\Base147 as Contract147;
    $b = new class extends CONTRACT147 { public int $number = 7; };
    echo $b::class, "|", $b->number, "|";
}
namespace {
    use Review147Vendor\Second147 as Contract147;

<?php
namespace Review147Actual\Parts {
    class Base {}
    interface Read {}
}
namespace Review147Relative\Local147 {
    class Base {}
    interface Read {}
}
namespace Review147Relative {
    use Review147Actual as Kit147;
    $a = new class extends kIT147\Parts\Base implements \Review147Actual\Parts\Read {};
    echo $a::class, "|", ($a instanceof \Review147Actual\Parts\Read ? "full" : "bad"), "|";
}
namespace Review147Relative {
    use Review147Actual\Parts\Base as Local147;
    $b = new class extends namespace\Local147\Base implements namespace\Local147\Read {};
    echo $b::class, "|", ($b instanceof \Review147Relative\Local147\Base ? "relative" : "bad");
}

<?php
namespace {
    $attempt147 = 0;
    function review147Load($name) {
        global $attempt147;
        echo "load:", $name, "|";
        if ($name === 'Review147Remote\Base') {
            eval('namespace Review147Remote; class Base {}');
        } elseif ($name === 'Review147Local\Read') {
            $attempt147++;
            if ($attempt147 === 1) { throw new Exception("pause"); }
            eval('namespace Review147Local; interface Read {}');
        }
    }
    spl_autoload_register('review147Load');
}
namespace Review147Local {
    use Review147Remote as Routed;
    use Review147Wrong as Read;
    function arg147() { echo "arg|"; return 7; }
    function make147() {
        $o = new class(arg147()) extends rOUTed\Base implements namespace\Read {
            public int $number = 0;
            public ?rOUTed\Base $ref = null;
            public function __construct($n) { echo "ctor|"; $this->number = $n; }
        };
        return $o;
    }
    try { make147(); } catch (\Exception $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|"; }
    $a = make147();
    $b = make147();
    $a->ref = $a;
    echo $a::class, "|", ($a::class === $b::class ? "same" : "bad"), "|", ($a !== $b ? "fresh" : "bad"), "|", ($a->ref === $a ? "typed" : "bad"), "|", $a->number;
}

<?php
namespace Review147Bad {
    use Review147Absent\Base as ParentAlias;
    use Review147Absent\Read as InterfaceAlias;
    echo "before|";
    if (false) {
        $o = new class extends ParentAlias implements InterfaceAlias {
            public ?ParentAlias $missing = 1;
        };
    }
    echo "after";
}

<?php
namespace {
    class Present147 {}
    interface Read147 {}
}
namespace Review147NoFallback {
    function arg147() { echo "arg|"; return 1; }
    try { $o = new class(arg147()) extends Present147 {}; }
    catch (\Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|"; }
    try { $o = new class(arg147()) implements Read147 {}; }
    catch (\Error $e) { echo $e->getMessage(), "|"; }
    echo "done";
}

<?php
namespace Model147FQ {
    class Base {
        public int $value = 2;
        public function __construct(int $value) { $this->value = $value; }
    }
}
namespace Client147FQ {
    function make() { return new class(7) extends \Model147FQ\Base {}; }
    $a = make();
    $b = make();
    echo $a::class, '|', $a->value, '/', $b->value, '|', $a !== $b ? 'fresh' : 'bad', '|', $a::class === $b::class ? 'same' : 'bad', '|', $a instanceof \Model147FQ\Base ? 'base' : 'bad';
}

<?php
namespace Defs147Group {
    interface Read { public function value(): int; }
    interface Tag {}
    class Base { public function value(): int { return 8; } }
}
namespace Client147Group {
    use Defs147Group\{Base as ParentAlias, Read as ReadAlias, Tag};
    class NamedPeer extends ParentAlias implements ReadAlias, Tag {}
    $peer = new class extends NamedPeer {};
    $direct = new class extends ParentAlias implements ReadAlias, Tag {};
    function consume(ReadAlias $item): int { return $item->value(); }
    echo $peer::class, '|', $direct::class, '|', consume($peer), '/', consume($direct), '|', $peer instanceof Tag ? 'tag' : 'bad', '|', $direct instanceof ParentAlias ? 'base' : 'bad';
}

<?php
namespace Target147Duplicate { interface Read {} }
namespace Client147Duplicate {
    use Target147Duplicate\Read as One;
    use Target147Duplicate\Read as Two;
    function argument() { echo 'arg|'; return 1; }
    echo 'before|';
    $o = new class(argument()) implements One, Two {};
    echo 'after';
}
